snippet.title: TROOOPS! trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Command a bizarre crew across a tiny, ever-changing archipelago. Give precise orders, outwit unshapely monsters, and survive the journey one squad at a time.

Check out this exclusive trailer for TROOOPS! by Le Slo and taletronic!

TROOOPS! in the Thinky Games DB: https://thinkygames.com/games/trooops/
TROOOPS! on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699510/TROOOPS/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
